list-content-records-v1.description: List one exact site: paginated posts/pages and status filters. No content write.

read-content-record-v1.description: Read native core and ACF definitions/raw values keyed by field keys. post_id=0 reads the new-draft precondition.

preview-content-edit-v1.description: Return exact before/candidate snapshots. No child content write. For creation use post_id=0 and explicit draft status/title/slug. ACF paths replace existing leaves only.

approve-content-edit-v1.description: Approve one reviewed digest with purpose-separated protected runtime QA. Human confirmation required.

confirm.description: False returns the retained exact review without approval or dispatch. True requires prior human approval.

execute-content-edit-v1.description: Execute once with exact human confirmation and a fresh same-site verified remote database backup. Independently read back. Never retry uncertain dispatch.

confirm.description: False returns the retained exact review without approval or dispatch. True requires prior human approval.

get-content-edit-v1.description: Read the retained operation outcome without repeating a write.

get-content-edit-migration-v1.description: Read the encrypted plan as a replayable structured migration bundle, without credentials.

preview-content-edit-rollback-v1.description: Prepare an exact inverse of a completed existing-record edit. New QA, review, confirmation and backup required.

hashes.candidate: SHA256(canonical candidate snapshot excluding post_id, unrelated_meta_sha256, post_record_sha256)
hashes.installed: SHA256(canonical complete independently read installed snapshot)
hashes.decimal_representation: Integers remain integers. Decimal inputs are canonical numeric strings. Raw ACF definition/value floats are projected to their JSON decimal string. No float is passed to delegation canonicalization.
hashes.empty_maps: PHP empty field maps/core are explicit empty arrays on this wire; no coercion to an object. Nonempty maps remain objects and lists remain lists.
